title: interface.v1
description: One interface between components (SWE.2 BP1). Stored as a fenced ```yaml interface block next to the components; this schema validates one block. That every edge of the architecture diagram is an interface and that from and to name components are gate rules of check_design_contract_gate; that every interface declares its implementations is a rule of check_testability_gate. An external interface names the security test templates its boundary needs (principle #16); that the component at the product's end has a passing test for each is a rule of verify_security_tests_gate.

id.description: The interface's ID — the ID of the diagram edge it comes from.

external.description: true when it crosses the system boundary (one end is an external actor).

protocol.description: How the two ends talk, e.g. HTTPS + JSON, in-process call, message queue.

security_templates.description: Principle #16: the security test templates the component at the product's end must pass, from the framework's catalog. Required when external is true.

implementations.description: Principle #15: what fills the 'to' end of the interface — the real implementation and a test double that replaces it in isolated tests. Optional in the schema; that every interface declares it is a rule of check_testability_gate.

real.description: The real implementation, e.g. HTTPS client of the auth service.
